What happens after you get in touch

No sales scripts. You talk to the people who would actually build your project.

1

We reply within one business day

We read your message, ask anything we need to understand the problem, and suggest a time to talk.

2

A discovery call

We go through your goals, users, timeline and budget, and tell you honestly whether we're the right fit.

3

A written proposal

You get a clear scope, recommended technology, a delivery plan in phases and a fixed or estimated cost.

4

Kick-off

Once you approve, we set up the project, share a timeline and show you working software early and often.

Common questions before you write

Can I keep my idea confidential?

Yes. Tell us in your message if you need a non-disclosure agreement before sharing detailed plans or data.

Do you work with clients outside Noida?

Yes. Most of our work runs remotely with regular video calls, and we can meet in person in Delhi NCR.

What if I only have an idea?

That's a good time to talk. We can help you shape a first version that is small enough to build quickly and test with real users.

How much will my project cost?

It depends on scope, integrations and timeline. After a short call we send a written estimate, so you know the cost before any work starts.
